feed_title: XXL Memory Foam Bolster Dog Bed 132 x 104cm, 20cm Deep, Memory Foam over Egg Crate, Three Bolsters with Open Front, Fleece | PawLunova Longsleddale
descriptionHtml:
132 × 104cm. Two foam layers. Room to lie out full length.

Longsleddale is an XXL memory foam bolster dog bed, 132 × 104 × 20cm, with bolsters on three sides, an open front and a fleece sleeping surface.

There are curlers and there are stretchers. A stretcher goes down, pushes the back legs out, and keeps going until something stops them. On most beds that is the wall, and the legs finish on the floorboards.

This one is 20cm deep and built so a long dog lies along a bolster rather than curled in the middle. Memory foam takes the contour, the egg-crate layer beneath carries the load.

What they get

  • 132 × 104cm, 20cm deep: Enough for a genuinely large dog at full stretch.
  • Memory foam over egg-crate foam: One layer follows the shape, one holds it up.
  • Three sides up, front left open: Somewhere to lean, nothing to climb.
  • Fleece inside, linen-effect panels out: Soft where they lie, tidy where the room sees it.

Best for: giant breeds who sleep flat out rather than curled up.

Why it is worth the money

£185 buys the second foam layer, which is the one a photograph cannot show you. A heavy dog on one thin layer is lying on your floor through fabric. Across the 1825 nights the foam guarantee runs, £185 is about 10p a night. And the 100 nights are yours. Free UK mainland collection if it is not right, and a full refund.

One limit worth knowing. There is no waterproof liner in this one, so the cover does all the protecting. If accidents are weekly, Burnmoor has a liner around its foam and this does not.

Size and fit

SizeExternal (cm)Suits
XXL, one size132 × 104 × 20Dogs who sleep at full stretch

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. These are outside measurements and the bolsters take up some of that. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Wash the cover to its sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

The questions we get asked most

How do I size it?

Measure them lying on their side and add 15 to 20cm.

When will it arrive?

Free over £40. Your postcode window shows by the basket button.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment options appear at checkout.

How much room is inside?

The area inside the bolsters is not published and we will not guess it.

Is it right for an older dog?

We can describe it, not predict it. Two foam layers, 20cm, no front wall.

Can I actually wash it?

The cover comes off and goes by its sewn-in label.

What if they never use it?

That is what the 100 nights are for. Free collection, full refund.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Give a stretcher 132 × 104cm and a bolster to lie along.
